title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.40325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unst

translated_title: 如何循环你的Transformer：循环缩放、特化与并行推理
translated_abstract: Transformer模型中的循环通过重复应用同一个Transformer（或其部分）来复用权重，使模型在不增加参数量的情况下变得更深。循环是否有用取决于哪种约束占主导：模型大小、训练算力，还是自回归推理效率。我们在从零开始训练的稠密decoder-only Transformer中联合研究这些权衡，改变模型中被循环的部分、循环次数以及循环之间信息传递的方式。实验涵盖了多达10亿参数的模型，使用多达1550亿token进行训练，计算量高达1.07×10²¹ FLOPs，循环次数最多32次。我们发现，在固定参数预算下，循环整个Transformer通常能获得最强的质量；而当训练FLOPs受限时，循环中间层块能带来更好的回报。增加循环次数并非总是有益：收益最终会饱和、逆转或变得不稳定。
tldr: 该研究系统探索了在不同约束下如何对Transformer进行循环复用：固定参数预算时循环整个模型效果最佳，训练算力受限时循环中间层块回报更好，且循环次数增加后收益最终会饱和甚至逆转。
en_tdlr: This work systematically studies how to loop Transformers under different constraints, finding that looping the full model is best under a fixed parameter budget, looping a middle block yields better returns when training FLOPs are limited, and gains from adding loops eventually saturate or reverse.
